# Pantry inventory tracker

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/pantry-tracker/

Record pantry items, quantities, locations and package-label dates, then sort and export a shopping or stock list.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

List flour, rice and canned beans, then sort by the dates copied from their packages.

## Limits and checks

A recorded date is not a food-safety determination. Follow the package instructions and relevant storage guidance; this tool cannot assess food condition.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
